title: Manipulating non-intrinsic outputs of a non-Hermitian coupled system by weak external driving
summary: Measurement provides access to exploring and understanding nature and finds widespread applications. It is generally believed that the weak external driving used in measurement introduces negligible disturbance to the intrinsic output of the probed system. Here, we reveal that dissipation in a non-Hermitian quantum coupled system induces interference between self-excitation and coupling-excitation spectral functions, giving rise to non-intrinsic outputs.
